title: Law requiring annual reports on NYC warming centers
summary: This bill would require the Department of Social Services, working with the Office of Emergency Management, to submit an annual public report on warming centers to the Mayor and Council Speaker. The report would list each center's location, space type, hours, staffing, visitor numbers and accessibility, and assess whether centers are geographically available to vulnerable populations. The first report would be due by April 15, 2027 and annually thereafter.
